note: v0.14.0：界面多语言上线——新增中文（全量）与西班牙语（核心，beta）界面，首次启动自动跟随系统语言，可在设置中随时切换；所有菜单、设置、弹窗、下载进度与提示信息均已本地化，新增内容自动跟随所选语言。同日：修复应用内更新必失败（Toast 线程崩溃）、新增自动更新弹窗。
noteEn: v0.14.0: The app now speaks your language — full Chinese and core Spanish (beta) interface translations. First launch auto-detects your system language; switch anytime in Settings. All menus, dialogs, download progress and messages are localized, and new screens follow your language automatically. Also today: fixed the in-app update failure (native toast crash) and added the auto update dialog.
